info.name: YouTube Analytics Analytics Groups VideoCategories API

params.name: part
params.description: Specifies a comma-separated list of one or more resource properties that the API response will include. The part parameter value must include the id property.

params.name: regionCode
params.description: Instructs the API to return the list of video categories available in the specified country.

params.name: id
params.description: Comma-separated list of video category IDs to retrieve.

params.name: hl
params.description: Specifies the language that will be used for text values in the API response.

params.name: fields
params.description: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response. Use this parameter to reduce bandwidth usage by selecting only the fields you need.

params.name: key
params.description: API key. Your API key identifies your project and provides you with API access, quota, and reports. Required unless you provide an OAuth 2.0 token.

items.docs: Returns a list of categories that can be associated with YouTube videos. Provide the hl parameter to specify the language for category names and regionCode to filter by region.
